pitch.title: Inbound Form
paragraphs: Pitch with clarity and conviction. We want to see what you are building, why it matters, and how you plan to ship it end to end.
Keep your deck focused and easy to scan. Deep dives on systems or mechanics can live in a separate GDD or design doc.
Show us something real. A playable build beats a video. A video beats concept art. We generally do not review pitches without a build or proof of concept.
GG collaborates on PC, Console, and mobile titles. AR/VR and mobile-first projects are welcome.

form.title: Gattabara Games Application Form
form.intro: Use this form to introduce your project or studio to Gattabara Games. We collaborate with solo creators and independent studios to co-create original games, aligning on vision, authorship, and long-term ownership.

labels.studioWebsiteHint: (If solo creator, link to portfolio or previous work)
labels.gameTitleHint: (This can be a working title or internal project codename.)
labels.collaboration: What kind of collaboration are you seeking?
labels.collabCoDevDesc: Hands-on creative and production collaboration with Gattabara to build the game together.
labels.collabCoFundingDesc: Financial support to help bring your game to life, including development, localisation, marketing, porting, etc.
labels.collabPublishingDesc: Gattabara supports release, distribution, marketing, and launch strategy while you retain creative authorship.
labels.descriptionHint: (Tell us what you’re building, why it matters, and what makes it distinct.)
labels.totalBudgetHint: (The estimated total cost to ship the project, including any spend to date.)
labels.budgetAskHint: (How much support are you seeking from Gattabara Games?)
labels.compTitleHint: (Based on gameplay, tone, and scope. Preferably released in the last 10 years.)
labels.materialsHint: We prioritize projects with something tangible to experience (playable builds, prototypes, vertical slices, or strong proof of concept. If available, include gameplay footage alongside your build.)
labels.materialsLinksHint: (Builds may fail to upload. Please include links to playable builds, pitch decks, gameplay videos, and access details here. If sharing Steam keys, please include at least 5 keys.)
labels.multiplayerHint: (Check the box if the build requires local/online multiplayer.)
labels.estimatedPriceHint: (Your current target price at launch. This can evolve.)
labels.teamSizeHint: (Number of people actively working on the project.)
labels.additionalNotesHint: (Anything else we should know about the project, team, or vision.)
labels.howHeard: How did you hear about Gattabara Games?
labels.howHeardHint: (Referral, person, event, community, etc. Helps us route your submission internally.)
labels.successMessage: Thank you for introducing your project. Our team will review your application and get back to you soon.
labels.alertRobot: Please verify that you are not a robot.
labels.alertFiles: You can only upload up to 5 files.
labels.alertSize: Total file size must be under 50MB.
labels.captchaNote: reCAPTCHA is changing its terms of service.
